statistic: all required manifests, artifact hashes, seals, custody events, and append-only links valid
required_inputs: packet, source, review, adjudication, and lineage seals
evidence_basis: fail-closed oracle integrity contract

statistic: all gate inputs and preregistered parameters present
required_inputs: gate parameter seal plus every required manifest and lineage binding
evidence_basis: missing inputs cannot become tracer failure or success

statistic: no source-role or evaluated-system reveal before confirmatory label seal
required_inputs: sampling, review, adjudication, reveal, and custody logs
evidence_basis: premature reveal invalidates confirmatory evaluation

statistic: tested-tracer, legacy, and library-presence membership leak count
required_inputs: reference rows, source manifest, construction protocol, and independence audit
evidence_basis: tested tracer cannot define its own recovery denominator

statistic: independent groups and effective sample size satisfy preregistered precision design
uncertainty_rule: preregistered confidence level, target bound or maximum interval width, and grouping sensitivity
required_inputs: sampling manifest, grouping keys, case counts, and parameter seal
evidence_basis: case count is driven by estimand precision, not a guessed universal number

statistic: minimal numeric review tables plus durable visual-evidence archive locator and hashes are replayable without RAW reopen
required_inputs: tracked calibration tables, visual-evidence archive locator, content hashes, and retention seal
evidence_basis: 0.98 remains calibrated but cannot support a portable formal gate until retained evidence is pinned

statistic: targeted-only authority leak into Untargeted count
required_inputs: sealed machine comparison and policy oracle
evidence_basis: authority leak cannot be averaged away

statistic: non-observed or hold-state rows projected as select_value count
required_inputs: proposal manifest and review oracle
evidence_basis: non-observed state cannot become a selected value

statistic: trusted existing value overwrite count
required_inputs: comparison manifest and immutable prior-value bindings
evidence_basis: diagnostic tracer has no overwrite authority

statistic: distinct missing, absent, unassessable, ambiguous, failed, or observed state collapse count
required_inputs: proposal manifest and oracle state labels
evidence_basis: state semantics cannot be repaired by aggregate accuracy

statistic: tracer or oracle lineage mismatch count
required_inputs: #123 identities, binding rows, artifact digests, and staleness status
evidence_basis: valid packet plus tracer lineage mismatch is a tracer defect

denominator: all replayable synthetic and retained no-RAW cases
statistic: identity, decision, area, and lineage digest mismatch count on frozen replay
required_inputs: frozen synthetic fixtures and retained replayable inputs
evidence_basis: repeated request must not drift

statistic: required synthetic scenario failure count
required_inputs: synthetic suite manifest and focused tests
evidence_basis: synthetic mechanics gate cannot establish scientific performance

statistic: machine boundary outside human conservative outer envelope count
required_inputs: sealed human boundaries and machine comparison
narrow_scope_rule: requires a separately passing preregistered scope
evidence_basis: 2RAW x 6 ISTD calibration

statistic: minimum machine area divided by deterministic human-envelope area
uncertainty_rule: report minimum, distribution, and grouping sensitivity
required_inputs: sealed boundaries, frozen morphology trace, and deterministic integrator
narrow_scope_rule: requires a separately passing preregistered scope
evidence_basis: observed calibration minimum 0.989616 with owner-accepted tail difference

statistic: targeted-worse shared-quality case count
required_inputs: sealed paired oracle and machine outcomes
narrow_scope_rule: requires a separately passing preregistered scope
evidence_basis: Targeted has additional prior but no lower quality allowance

statistic: targeted correct cell count minus Untargeted correct cell count
uncertainty_rule: report paired discordance counts and one-sided uncertainty descriptively
required_inputs: control census, paired Targeted and Untargeted oracle outcomes, and owner policy seal
evidence_basis: cid_nl_oracle_owner_policy_seal records owner, scope, rationale, timestamp, and decision hash

statistic: Untargeted correct recovery proportion over the complete bounded control census
uncertainty_rule: descriptive finite-census result with hypothesis, sample, and injection-order sensitivity; no binomial sampling CI for the same census
required_inputs: control census, oracle labels, machine outcomes, and parameter seal
narrow_scope_rule: requires a separately passing preregistered scope
evidence_basis: relative non-inferiority cannot hide shared misses

statistic: design-appropriate estimate or preregistered lower bound for supported select_value proportion
uncertainty_rule: census is descriptive; probability sample uses preregistered design weights, confidence level, and cluster-aware uncertainty; challenge rows are descriptive only
required_inputs: proposal manifest, oracle labels, sampling design, grouping keys, and parameter seal
narrow_scope_rule: precision failure narrows automation scope but cannot override hard blockers
evidence_basis: recovery prioritized; threshold requires observed prevalence and owner tradeoff

statistic: design-appropriate estimate or preregistered lower bound for supported-positive recovery
uncertainty_rule: census is descriptive; probability sample uses preregistered weights, confidence level, and cluster-aware uncertainty; incomplete frame limits the claim to known-reference recovery
required_inputs: reference universe, machine comparison, sampling design, grouping keys, and parameter seal
narrow_scope_rule: requires a separately passing preregistered scope
evidence_basis: recovery denominator remains independent of proposals

statistic: design-appropriate lower bound for exact dimension-wise agreement
uncertainty_rule: use preregistered confidence level when duplicate cases are probability sampled; report transitions and identity, observation, peak, boundary, and policy agreement separately
required_inputs: primary and duplicate pre-adjudication review records plus parameter seal
evidence_basis: hidden duplicates estimate intra-rater stability, not correctness or inter-rater reproducibility

statistic: design-appropriate estimate or upper bound for human unassessable proportion
uncertainty_rule: census is descriptive; sampled frame uses preregistered design, confidence level, and reason-code strata
required_inputs: primary review records, sampling design, and parameter seal
evidence_basis: unassessable is a completed state, not machine hold or tracer error

statistic: machine non-hold final call count divided by all primary cases
uncertainty_rule: report overall and reference-positive class coverage; use design-aware uncertainty only for sampled frames
required_inputs: proposal manifest, machine comparison, and owner policy seal
narrow_scope_rule: requires a passing scope from the sealed narrow-scope manifest
evidence_basis: cid_nl_oracle_owner_policy_seal records owner, scope, rationale, timestamp, and decision hash

statistic: design-appropriate estimate or upper bound for error among non-hold final calls
uncertainty_rule: report jointly with overall coverage, positive-class coverage, proposal precision, and unconditional reference recovery
required_inputs: proposal manifest, oracle labels, sampling design, grouping keys, and parameter seal
narrow_scope_rule: requires a separately passing preregistered scope
evidence_basis: coverage alone can hide selective abstention on difficult positives

statistic: #128 runtime and resource budget satisfied
required_inputs: #128 budget seal and processing-attempt metrics
narrow_scope_rule: scientific-evaluation-only scope must pass all non-performance gates
evidence_basis: speed cannot relax scientific gates
